meta.project: Rhode Island Hurricane — Mental Health & Self-Help Center
meta.verification_definition: Official or recognized source content was checked on research date. No provider was contacted; availability is not independently confirmed.
coverage_limits: Not a census of every private clinician, AA/NA meeting, school service or faith community.
Meeting records are a selected, audited subset plus official live finders; all Jamestown AA entries found at St. Matthew’s are retained with stale-source warnings.
No current individual Rhode Island Nar-Anon meeting confirmed.
All 39 municipalities have regional access mapping; this does not mean all have a local clinic.
meta.paywall_policy: All records, crisis contacts, support services, filters and source links remain public without registration or payment.
meta.safety_policy: No diagnosis, psychiatric risk scoring or automated treatment recommendations.
